rows.p: [Naṭa+a] (pu) CL=9 Naṭaṃ nacce, a. Naṭatīti naṭo. Sūci. Naṭa natiyaṃ. Naṭati, naṭo. Nīti,dhā.53. Naṭa avasandane, avasandanaṃ gattavikkhepo. Nīti,dhā.296.(ṇaṭṭa-prā, natye, hiṃsane ca. Thoma).] (1) (a) dancer / performer. (b) leader / director of performance. (c) Naṭajātaka . (2) trumpet flower fruit. (Neuter gender) (3) behavior of drunker. (three genders) (4) a person who is born in the family / ancestry of dancer.
